title: My Video Got 2 Companies Shut Down! (And even worse negative ion products)
summary: The Thought Emporium follows up on his earlier video showing negative ion products are radioactive, reporting that Amazon pulled listings and companies shut down. He tests more radioactive quack products with a Geiger counter and cloud chamber.
why: HN points to it as an example of a YouTuber getting radioactive scam products delisted by reporting them to the NRC.

quote.text: This guy on youtube contacted the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission to force Amazon to delist these products
